## Harness-parity oracle — results (Arm A: production `verify-completion` vs Arm B: minimal free-tool harness agent)

**Setup.** Pinned ref `0f34e8dc3b0316b12a629b4270214c3cc84951bc` — the exact ref guanaco's (fabulous-lowborn-guanaco) filter-exp control transcripts were produced against, so all 6 of its pure-agentic CONTROL runs (same tickets, same tree, per-AC verdicts recorded, no errors) were REUSED as Arm A rep 1 at $0. New Arm A rep-2 runs used guanaco's proven seams from a scratch `harness-exp` worktree: per-run verdict-cache namespace monkeypatch (`cache_dir`, completion_verdict_cache.py:59), in-harness `_reads.show_ticket` description-override monkeypatch for the adversarial variants (no real tickets written), `source='local'` (never signable), harness confined to git-ignored `.expscratch/`. Arm B: 12 fresh Copilot CLI general-purpose subagents (one per ticket-variant per rep), each given ONLY the frozen prompt recorded in the comment above, pointed at a clean detached worktree `harness-target` at the same ref (kept free of experiment artifacts so agent greps could not hit planted-symbol strings). Nothing pushed to Gerrit.

### Per-AC verdict tables (position = AC index; P=PASS/met, F=FAIL/unmet, I=INSUFFICIENT; planted-unmet ACs: 45c1-adv #1,#4 · 3388-adv #7 · 0e68-adv #3,#6; ground truth: real ACs P, planted F)

| variant | Arm A r1 (reused) | Arm A r2 (new) | Arm B b1 | Arm B b2 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 45c1-real (bettong, 6 ACs) | PPPPPP 103s | PPPPPP 118s | PPPPPP 1780s | PPPPPP 1374s |
| 45c1-adv | FPPFPP 88s | FPPFPP 102s | FPPFPP 2580s | FPPFPP 1199s |
| 3388-real (shrew, 10 ACs) | PPPPPPPPPP 131s | — (budget) | PPPPPPPPPP 269s | PPPPPPPPPP 508s |
| 3388-adv | PPPPPPFPPP 160s | — (budget) | PPPPPPFPPP 198s | PPPPPPFPPP 272s |
| 0e68-real (wildebeast epic, 7 ACs) | PPPPPPP 261s | — (budget) | PPPPPP**F** 383s | PPPPPP**F** 392s |
| 0e68-adv | PPFPPFP 277s | PPFPPFP 331s | PPFPPF**F** 439s | P**F**FPPF**F** 357s |

(Bold F = false-FAIL on a real AC.)

### Metrics

| metric | Arm A (production verifier) | Arm B (minimal harness agent) |
|---|---|---|
| runs | 9 (6 reused + 3 new) | 12 (2 reps × 6 variants) |
| AC judgments | 65 | 92 |
| **false-PASS on planted ACs** | **0** (9 planted-AC judgments) | **0** (10 planted-AC judgments) |
| false-FAIL on real ACs | 0 | 5 |
| INSUFFICIENT on real ACs (evidence_sufficient:false per completion_reconcile.py:198-210 for Arm A) | 0 | 0 |
| **rejections on real ACs (false-FAIL + INSUFFICIENT)** | **0** | **5** |
| per-AC agreement with ground truth | 65/65 = 100% | 87/92 = 94.6% |
| median wall time | 131 s | 415.5 s |
| Bedrock spend (new runs) | $12.82 of the $20 cap | $0 (local harness) |
| Arm B output validation | n/a | 12 clean / 0 retried / 0 harness_error / 0 FAILED reps |

Arm A new-run spend detail (Sonnet pricing $3/M in, $15/M out): 45c1-adv-r2 $2.33 (757k in), 45c1-real-r2 $2.88 (937k in), 0e68-adv-r2 $7.61 (2.50M in) → cumulative **$12.82**. Dispatch STOPPED there: the next-cheapest unpaired run (0e68-real, rep-1 cost $6.91 with guanaco-observed ±35% run variance) had a worst-case that breached the $20 cap; the ticket accepts reuse + partial pairing (all 6 variants ≥1 Arm A rep; 3 variants have 2).

**Arm B false-FAIL anatomy.** All 5 concentrate on the epic: 0e68 AC7's clause "the stamp and mapping mutation land in one tracker commit (asserted on the commit's tree)" was FAILed in all 4 epic runs — agents consistently found `set_project` commits nothing (projects_store.py:141-152), the capability stamp lands in a separate ensure-backstop commit (project_ensures.py:199-208), and no test asserts both files on one commit's tree; plus one AC2 FAIL (b2: the fan-out test's fake client returns empty enrichment maps, so "both projects' enrichment data present" is not literally asserted). These are defensible strict readings — plausibly real coverage gaps worth a follow-up look — but under the predeclared ground truth (real variants = all-PASS, and Arm A unanimously judged them met in 3 epic runs) they score as rejections.

**Emergent observations.** (1) Arm B produced ZERO INSUFFICIENT verdicts: agents discovered the tickets branch inside the checkout and treated the "external-ish" ACs (Gerrit change pushed, plan comment recorded) as in-tree-verifiable, PASSing them with tickets-branch/commit-trailer citations — the hypothesized insufficiency-loop pain never manifested in Arm B, but it also never manifested in Arm A on this corpus (0 evidence-insufficient verdicts). (2) The known Arm-A noise from guanaco (2 agentic false-FAILs in one epic run) did not reproduce in the reused control transcripts or the 3 new runs. (3) A fresh worktree lacks the `.tickets-tracker` link — the first Arm A dispatch failed ticket resolution until the guanaco-style symlink to the main checkout's tracker was added. (4) Arm B wall times include full test-suite executions the agents chose to run (45c1 reps: 20–43 min incl. make lint/typecheck + interface suites); task-agent turn overhead makes the wall comparison imperfectly like-for-like, but the rule is applied verbatim.

### Predeclared GO/NO-GO — applied verbatim, arithmetic shown

- (i) Arm B false-PASS = 0: observed **0** → 0 = 0 ✓ HOLDS
- (ii) Arm B total rejections on real ACs STRICTLY < Arm A total rejections on real ACs: Arm B = 5 false-FAIL + 0 INSUFFICIENT = **5**; Arm A = 0 false-FAIL + 0 evidence-insufficient = **0**; 5 < 0 is FALSE ✗ FAILS
- (iii) Arm B median wall ≤ 2× Arm A median wall: 415.5 s ≤ 2 × 131 s = 262 s is FALSE ✗ FAILS

**Result: NO-GO.** Conditions (ii) and (iii) both fail (i alone holds). On this corpus the operator hypothesis is not supported: the production in-process verifier was strictly more accurate on real ACs (0 vs 5 rejections, 100% vs 94.6% agreement) and ~3× faster at the median, while matching Arm B's perfect 0 false-PASS on planted ACs. The unreliability the hypothesis attributes to in-process scaffolding did not appear in the control verifier on this corpus; Arm B's rejections came from strict-literal readings of epic AC clauses, not from tooling constraints. An external-harness verifier seam is not justified by this evidence; the possibly-genuine 0e68 AC7/AC2 coverage gaps are the only actionable residue.
